text:
## Abstract  
We asked whether the NIAID Data Ecosystem (NDE) contains any records that simultaneously annotate the bacterial species Escherichia coli and the viral pathogen influenza (specifically Influenza A virus). Querying the graph index with two independent Lucene expressions—(i) `species.name:"Escherichia coli" AND influenza` and (ii) `species.name:"Escherichia coli" AND infectiousAgent.name:"Influenza A virus"`—returned 0 hits out of ~14 million indexed objects. These results indicate that, within the current release of the NDE (queried 2024-06-29), no dataset, sample, tool, or other record simultaneously references E. coli and influenza. Awareness of such absences is important for guiding data discovery and highlighting potential areas where new integrative studies—or improved metadata curation—may be needed.

## I. Introduction  
Background. Escherichia coli is a widely studied bacterial model and frequent pathogen, whereas influenza viruses are major human and animal pathogens. Investigators sometimes employ bacterial hosts (e.g., E. coli) for recombinant expression of influenza proteins or study mixed infections; therefore, it is reasonable to ask whether datasets exist that mention both organisms.  
Literature Review. No literature was retrieved for this query.  
Knowledge Gap. The prevalence of records jointly referencing E. coli and influenza within the NDE has not been documented.  
Objective & Hypothesis. We aimed to determine whether any NDE records annotate both E. coli and influenza; we hypothesised that at least a few recombinant-protein datasets might meet this criterion.

## II. Materials and Methods  
Study Design. A direct Boolean search strategy was applied to the NDE via the `nde_raw_query` tool to capture any record containing both taxa in relevant metadata fields.  
Materials.  
• NDE (via `nde_raw_query`)  
Procedures.  
1. Query 1: `nde_raw_query` with `q="species.name:\"Escherichia coli\" AND influenza"`, size = 10, offset = 0, summarize = true.  
2. Query 2: `nde_raw_query` with `q="species.name:\"Escherichia coli\" AND infectiousAgent.name:\"Influenza A virus\""`, same size and offset.  
Statistical Analysis. For each query we recorded `total`, the number of matching records reported by NDE. No deduplication was necessary because totals were zero.

## III. Results  
### Data Presentation  
Table 1. Hit counts for combined E. coli + influenza searches in NDE (queried 2024-06-29).

| Query | Total records found |
|-------|--------------------|
| species.name:"Escherichia coli" AND influenza | 0 |
| species.name:"Escherichia coli" AND infectiousAgent.name:"Influenza A virus" | 0 |

### Findings  
Both targeted queries returned zero results, indicating no NDE record presently links E. coli with influenza (any free-text mention or explicit infectiousAgent annotation).

## IV. Discussion  
Interpretation. The absence of hits falsifies our hypothesis; within the current NDE snapshot, there is no evidence of datasets, samples, or tools that concurrently reference E. coli and influenza.  
Context. Because NDE integrates metadata from >50 repositories, this negative result suggests either (a) such datasets have not been deposited in those repositories, or (b) existing records lack dual-organism annotation.  
Limitations. Searches relied on exact species and pathogen names; alternative spellings (e.g., “flu virus,” “IAV”) might evade the filters. Additionally, repository metadata might be incomplete; records could contain implicit—but unindexed—links between the two organisms.  
Conclusion & Future Directions. No influenza-related data were found among E. coli-annotated NDE records. Future efforts could (i) broaden queries to include synonyms of influenza, (ii) examine other databases (e.g., ENA, GEO) directly, and (iii) encourage submitters to supply comprehensive metadata for multi-organism studies.

## References

[2] NDE API call for Query 2: https://api.data.niaid.nih.gov/v1/query?q=species.name%3A%22Escherichia+coli%22+AND+infectiousAgent.name%3A%22Influenza+A+virus%22&size=10&_source=_id%2C%40type%2Cname%2Cdescription%2Curl%2Cdoi%2Cidentifier%2Cdate%2CdatePublished%2CdateModified%2CincludedInDataCatalog.name%2CincludedInDataCatalog.url%2CincludedInDataCatalog.archivedAt%2Cauthor.name%2CinfectiousAgent.name%2CinfectiousAgent.displayName%2Cspecies.name%2ChealthCondition.name%2CmeasurementTechnique.name%2CtopicCategory.name%2Ckeywords%2CconditionsOfAccess%2Clicense%2Cdistribution.contentUrl%2CsourceOrganization.name%2Cfunding.funder.name%2CprogrammingLanguage%2CapplicationCategory%2CoperatingSystem%2CsoftwareVersion%2CcodeRepository%2CisBasedOn.identifier%2CvariableMeasured.name%2Cvalue%2CunitText%2CmarginOfError.name%2CmarginOfError.value%2CobservationAbout.name%2CobservationAbout.identifier%2CmeasuredProperty.name%2CobservationType.name%2CmeasurementQualifier%2CsubjectOf.identifier
